changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwprogressnotes AS SELECT pn.id, pn.patient_id, pn.encounter_id, pn.note_text, pn.created_by, pn.created_date, pn.last_modified_by, pn.last_modified_date, pn.cancelled_by, pn.cancelled_date, pn.cancellation_reason FROM public.progress_notes pn;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwprogressnotes TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwprogressnotes FROM report_user;
